data.reason_zh: 仅一次SFT冷启动加在线RL训练，用失败恢复经验改进模型，但无多轮自生成训练闭环，非持续RSI。

scope_support.exclusion_quote: we propose ReTerm-GRPO, an online RL algorithm that forks from the agent's own failure states to generate multiple independent self-recovery attempts.
scope_support.feedback_quote: By learning from whether these attempts successfully complete the task, the agent self-improves through its own recovery experience.
scope_support.object_quote: we present ReTerm, a self-improving terminal agent trained by learning how to recover from its own failed terminal tasks.
